Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Subject: PO number / spend cap discrepancy for onboarding

Hi Connor / Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. I attached our completed onboarding form and the vendor SKU list for OrbitWorks (see attachments). Two issues came up on our end during finance review that we need clarified before we can accept a PO:

1) The purchase reference on your side is showing as a provisional token (blank PO) in several line items — our ERP needs a serialized PO number for invoice routing.
2) The spend cap listed in the onboarding packet (USD 50k) doesn't match the conditional spend band we discussed on the call (USD 75k).

Could you confirm whether you can:
- Issue a provisional PO number now for vendor setup while final spend cap is confirmed, OR
- Wait to assign until the spend cap is finalized (this will delay our invoice flow).

Also, there are three line items where quantities were merged into a single ledger code — please see the CSV and advise how you want these split so our itemization matches the invoice.

Thanks — we need this clarified by EOD Monday to keep the July SOW milestones intact.

Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager
OrbitWorks Ltd.
Attachments: orbitworks_onboarding_form.pdf, vendor_sku_list.csv
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO number / spend cap discrepancy for onboarding

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear note and the attachments. Short answers below and next steps.

- We can provision a temporary PO token for vendor setup today (internal label: PO-TEMP) so your ERP can accept invoices immediately. Once spend cap is finalized we will replace it with a serialized PO number that matches your ERP format.
- I see the spend cap mismatch — the onboarding form pulled the standard starter band (50k). After the call I confirmed with Billing that we can set the band to USD 75,000 for OrbitWorks pending internal approval from Procurement (Ben is looping in Approval).
- For the three merged line items: please confirm whether you need them split by SKU or by ledger code. Our preference is SKU-level splits to keep downstream reporting consistent, but we can map to your ledger codes if you provide the mappings.

Action items for us:
- I will create a temporary PO token today and notify you of the ID.
- Ben, can Procurement confirm the 75k band and create the PROC ticket to track the serialized PO issuance?
- Priyom, attaching a brief scope summary (scope_summary.docx) explaining the mapping we propose — we need OrbitWorks to confirm mapping or share your ledger codes.

Connor O'Brien
Account Manager, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
